description: Production-grade miss-rate suite: packages TypeScript teams actually choose and write code against, pinned across a real major boundary. Selected on installs and on whether the major genuinely moved — never on whether a model gets it wrong, which is the question this suite exists to answer. Every version pair is a real published release, read from the npm registry on 2026-08-08. Paired cases (the previous major and the current one) are the point: the previous major is the control a model trained before the bump should handle, and the difference between the two is the drift. Tasks state the outcome and never name the symbols to use, because naming them would be handing over the answer.
